sloka: महादासीत्ततस्तेषां तुल्यं स्थानमवाप्य तत् ।आकाशयुद्धं तुमुलं देवदानवयोरिव ।। ७.२३.३४ ॥
transliteration: mahādāsīttatasteṣāṁ tulyaṁ sthānamavāpya tat ।ākāśayuddhaṁ tumulaṁ devadānavayoriva ।। 7.23.34 ॥

translations.english: After obtaining an equal position in the sky, a great and tumultuous battle ensued among them, resembling the fierce combat between gods and demons.
